title.zh: 最终觉醒 / 教育的失败
title.en: Final Awakening / A Failure of Education

excerpt.zh: 学徒们，虚境宣昭了警告。巨大的危机近在眼前，整个星系都处在毁灭的边缘。我们的预知显示，我们自身的力量无法匹配即将到来的威胁。与其被毁灭，我们现在将灌输给你们最后一课：所有的幻梦都有苏醒之时。我们离开这个世界的时刻已经到了。尽管虚境十分黑暗，飘忽不定，我们最终将会升往一个新的位面，一个新的世界，在那里继续传播我们的教义。我们将离开这个星系，将它的命运交付给你。希望我们以往的功课能在必要之时为你提供指引。
excerpt.en: Apprentices, the Shroud has given warning. A moment of great crisis is at hand, and the galaxy stands on the brink of ruin. Our divinations have shown we are no match for the coming threat. Rather than be destroyed, we now impart our final lesson: every dream

note.zh: 两个守门事件都要求全局标记 shroudwalkers_departed 尚未设置，并在 after 中设置它并销毁虚境行者城邦；因此“危机降临”(4240)与“你就是危机”(4245)互斥。
note.en: Both gatekeepers require the global flag shroudwalkers_departed to be unset and set it (destroying the Shroudwalker enclave) afterwards, so the crisis farewell (4240) and the you-are-the-crisis farewell (4245) are alternatives.

enclave.4245.zh: 虚境行者告别（你即危机）

texts.zh: 学徒们，虚境宣昭了警告。巨大的危机近在眼前，整个星系都处在毁灭的边缘。我们的预知显示，我们自身的力量无法匹配即将到来的威胁。与其被毁灭，我们现在将灌输给你们最后一课：所有的幻梦都有苏醒之时。我们离开这个世界的时刻已经到了。尽管虚境十分黑暗，飘忽不定，我们最终将会升往一个新的位面，一个新的世界，在那里继续传播我们的教义。我们将离开这个星系，将它的命运交付给你。希望我们以往的功课能在必要之时为你提供指引。
texts.en: Apprentices, the Shroud has given warning. A moment of great crisis is at hand, and the galaxy stands on the brink of ruin. Our divinations have shown we are no match for the coming threat. Rather than be destroyed, we now impart our final lesson: every dream has its awakening. The time has come for us to pass beyond this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world in which to spread our teachings. We leave this galaxy and its fate to you. May our past lessons be a guide in your time of need.

notes.zh: 审阅注：由每月国家脉冲（00_on_actions.txt:339）上的隐藏守门事件 enclave.4239 触发：存在危机（偶发危机/维度外来者/普雷索林）、未被击败、虚境行者城邦在场，对每个“虚境导师”起源的帝国发出本窗口，然后销毁虚境行者城邦并设置 shroudwalkers_departed（:7756-7796）。
notes.en: Review note: hidden gatekeeper enclave.4239 on the monthly country pulse (00_on_actions.txt:339) needs a live, undefeated crisis (Contingency, Extradimensionals or Prethoryn) and a Shroudwalker enclave; it sends this window to every Teachers of the Shroud empire, then destroys the enclave and sets shroudwalkers_departed (overlord_enclaves_events.txt:7756-7796).

label.zh: 虚境行者离去（外来危机）

note.zh: a：20年“敬畏”修正；b：20年“愤怒”修正；两者之后都获得50零。
note.en: a: 20-year reverence modifier; b: 20-year anger modifier; both then grant 50 Zro.

texts.zh:
虚境自身在战栗，一切迹象都指向毁灭。常年以来我们注视着你，但即便是我们也无法预见你竟愚蠢到如此境地。欲速则不达。心急地攫取力量，那么你注定会失去它。你忘记了最基本的一课：虚境不是能用来开发的资源，而是用来品鉴的谜题。但是学生的覆辙和老师没有关系。相比于目睹你会成为怎样的可憎之物，我们宁愿离开这个世界。尽管虚境的道路黑暗且变幻不定，我们最终会到达一个新的位面，新的世界。或许在那里我们会找到有价值的学生，传达我们的教义。

希望虚境能对你展现仁慈。
texts.en:
The Shroud itself shivers, and all signs point to ruin. Long have we watched you, but even we could not have foreseen the extent of your folly. Rushing to act, you will falter. In grasping power, it has already been lost. You have fogotten the most basic lesson: the Shroud is not a resource to exploit, but a mystery to be savoured. But the failure of the student rests with the teacher. Rather than witness the horror you will become, we have chosen to depart this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world. Perhaps there, we will find apprentices worthy of our teachings.

May the Shroud have mercy on you.

label.zh: 曾经我们是学生。现在轮到我们当大师了。
label.en: Once we were students. Now we are Masters.

notes.zh: 审阅注：守门事件 enclave.4244（00_on_actions.txt:341）要求帝国自身达到危机等级5（玩家成为危机）。更早的等级2会触发警告 enclave.4243（属于“虚境导师”起源故事，不在此家族内）。
notes.en: Review note: gatekeeper enclave.4244 (00_on_actions.txt:341) needs crisis level 5 (the player is the crisis). The earlier warning enclave.4243 at level 2 belongs to the Teachers of the Shroud origin story, not to this family (overlord_enclaves_events.txt:7836-7917).

label.zh: 虚境行者离去（玩家即危机）
label.en: The Shroudwalkers depart (the player is the crisis)

note.zh: 奖励同“外来危机”告别：依选择获得20年的“敬畏”或“愤怒”修正，随后获得50 Zro。
note.en: Same reward as the external-crisis farewell: a 20-year reverence or anger modifier (by choice), then 50 Zro.

summary.text:
# 最终觉醒 / 教育的失败 — 虚境行者离去 / The Shroudwalkers Depart

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：霸主 Overlord（“虚境导师”起源）

## 如何开始 How it starts
每月检查（隐藏守门事件）。仅对“虚境导师”起源的帝国发出窗口。
Monthly gatekeeper checks; only Teachers of the Shroud empires see a window.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
- 外来危机爆发（偶发危机、维度外来者、普雷索林）且未被击败：enclave.4239 → 4240“最终觉醒”。
- 玩家自己成为危机（危机等级5）：enclave.4244 → 4245“教育的失败”。（等级2时更早出现警告 4243，属于起源故事。）
- 两种情形都会销毁虚境行者城邦并设置 shroudwalkers_departed，因此只会发生一次。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes
两个窗口各有两个选项：a 敬畏（20年修正 shroudwalkers_depart_reverence），b 愤怒（shroudwalkers_depart_anger）；之后都获得50零。4245 另设置成就标记。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants
窗口只对 origin_shroudwalker_apprentice 起源的帝国发出；有可汗危机或灰色风暴危机时守门事件不触发。
